test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Six friends Priti, Kamal, Rohit, Sweety, Meenu and Umesh, are sitting in a circle (but not necessarily in the same order). Their faces are towards the centre. Meenu is sitting second to the left of Rohit. Umesh is sitting between Rohit and Priti. Sweety is sitting to the immediate right of Priti.

Who is sitting between Rohit and Meenu?
solution:
**Given:** Six friends Priti, Kamal, Rohit, Sweety, Meenu and Umesh, are sitting in a circle. Their faces are towards the centre.

1) Meenu is sitting second to the left of Rohit.

2) Umesh is sitting between Rohit and Priti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3303d68f9d2d81a161f40e4ac758476deb762e04b19123d5f3638ac4c5c46ba.png] 

3) Sweety is sitting to the immediate right of Priti.

After positioning Sweety only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Kamal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b54015ce13b40343d86ce689df5cd83f7b625f71acd9f09f9b4cf2399f7befff.png] 

Thus, Kamal is sitting between Rohit and Meenu.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
